content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends annual screening for diabetic peripheral neuropathy (DPN) in individuals with type 1 diabetes who have had the disease for five or more years, as well as in all individuals with type 2 diabetes. The clinical presentation of DPN can vary depending on which sensory nerve fibers are affected. Electrophysiological testing is not routinely performed for DPN diagnosis but may be required in cases where the clinical features are atypical. Screening for DPN also involves evaluating for other potential non-diabetic causes of neuropathy, such as deficiencies in vitamins, infections, or the presence of other chronic diseases.
